name: zero-slop
description: Edits AI-assisted prose with an explainable local meter, source-bound contextual review, fidelity gates, fresh final editors, and private reason-labelled learning.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI-sounding prose. Keep every fact. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: A guarded editorial system: it measures a draft with an interpretable local surface score, can add source-bound contextual review, audits repeated templates, rewrites with fidelity first, runs dedicated copy and read-aloud passes, and learns from later human edits through a private reason-labelled overlay. Classic mode remains the rollback path; contextual behavior is shadow-tested before promotion. Draft scoring stays local and dependency-free; the optional release check sends only a version query.
